cases.assertion: Invoking article-flow with no arguments returns the complete bootstrap protocol with every skill adapter absent.
A replacement provider can continue from validated task packets alone.
Changing one protected byte fails integrity and authoring health.
The Windows and WSL global commands resolve one controller/workflow version through their own managed homes.
Every stage packet declares inputs, hashes, schema, tools, stop conditions, and escalation.
Model assertions cannot pass deterministic link, hash, package, approval, or revision checks.
No-search mode omits, generalizes, uses an approved corpus, or escalates; memory citations fail.
Profile promotion requires held-out author calibration on another form.
Promotion requires order reversal and passage-specific human calibration.
A recipe requires distinct outline candidates, selection reason, recent-post comparison, and macro variation.
Recipe selection records reader-job fit; novelty alone is not a criterion.
Changed locked numbers, dates, links, code, quotations, or citations reopen verification.
The same revision and approval produce one recorded publication result.
HTTP 200 with nonmatching bytes fails live verification.
The receipt keeps indexing unknown unless separately proved.
Supersession and archival require explicit redirect and surface checks.
Protected drift blocks package and any dirty checkout blocks publication execution.
A stale global command reports its exact repair command.
Similar seeds receive distinct run IDs, directories, locks, and logs.
A model score cannot promote a route when human calibration falls or is absent.
One unstructured sentence or paragraph is preserved verbatim, starts a resumable run, and remains findable without reconstructing context.
The public title and description receive voice review and can be repaired without replaying completed research or drafting.
An explicit targeted repair clears exhausted counters for that stage without erasing completed upstream work.
When no independent verifier exists, the only eligible route can continue only with an explicit independence limitation.
A failed verification transport is not reported as evidence that the cited source itself is broken.
A local commit cannot satisfy a publication handoff unless it is the current remote publication-branch head and every planned public blob matches.
